donnees.titre: Evaluation the Safety and Effectiveness of the GORE GDI in Adult Subjects With Primary Open-angle Glaucoma in Whom Previous Medical and Surgical Treatment Have Failed.
donnees.titre_officiel: A Prospective, Multicenter, Single-Cohort, Open-Label Clinical Study Designed to Evaluate the Safety and Effectiveness of the GORE® Glaucoma Drainage Implant (GORE GDI) in Subjects With Primary Open Angle Glaucoma in Whom Previous Medical and Surgical Treatment Have Failed.

criteres_principaux.critere: Proportion of subjects achieving a ≥ 20% reduction in MDIOP

donnees.resume_source: Evaluation the Safety and Effectiveness of the GORE GDI in Adult Subjects With Primary Open-angle Glaucoma in Whom Previous Medical and Surgical Treatment Have Failed.

eligibilite.criteres:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of primary open-angle glaucoma (POAG) with IOP uncontrolled by medical therapy and failed surgical treatment
* Medicated IOP of \>=20 mmHg
* Shaffer angle grade \>= 2 in target quadrant
* Area of free and mobile conjunctiva without extensive scarring or fibrosis
* At least 46 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* Closed-angle and secondary glaucomas
* Any pathology or condition (including prior glaucoma filtration or conjunctival surgery) that prevents implantation of the study device in the target quadrant
* Diagnosis of degenerative visual disorders
* History of corneal transplantation, prior corneal surgery, corneal opacities inhibiting visualization, or clinically significant corneal disease pathology
* Non-study eye with BCVA worse than 20/200
* Pregnant or nursing women; or women of childbearing potential not using medically acceptable birth control
